dominant_strengths: 3D hero objects showcase the product's core capability natively—the medium is the message, with believable lighting and depth
Vibrant gradient blobs against pure black create strong visceral pop and signal creative-tool energy
Interactive 'press and drag to orbit' affordance turns the marketing surface into a live demo, rare and confident
dominant_weaknesses: Headline competes visually with chaotic 3D shapes behind it, reducing legibility and creating figure-ground tension at center
Top utility bar 'Meet Omma' feels typographically generic and disconnected from the playful 3D system below
Nav lockup floats awkwardly with too much horizontal whitespace between logo, links, and CTA cluster
fix_priorities: Add subtle radial vignette or blur behind headline to separate type from 3D scene without killing the depth
Tighten nav spacing and align Meet Omma banner styling with the brand's playful 3D vocabulary
Increase headline weight contrast or scale to assert hierarchy over the busy backdrop
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral dominates through 3D spectacle; behavioral is solid via the orbit interaction, but reflective meaning gets slightly buried under decorative noise.
rationale.intent_fit: Strong fit—a 3D design tool literally demonstrating its output as the hero is the most honest possible pitch.
